failures.evidence: docs/kubernetes.md:2799 (and the PR body's E2E (implementer) line, and implement.json proof[0].observed) record the reachability check 'answering by the Service name on its first try'. The published block prints nothing per attempt, so no run of it can observe a first try, and the run behind the bullet contradicts it: the implementer's own log ($TMPDIR/infra234/run1/out.log) has the check starting at T0+71s = 06:43:45Z, the Job's log 'listening on IPv4 address "0.0.0.0", port 5432' at 06:43:46.370, and the next step at T0+73s, the 2 s gap of one refused attempt and the loop's sleep. Measured directly: the same block with one print per attempt added (driver2.sh, workload infra-234-postgres-e7ad30, 2026-10-25 06:56:03Z) printed 'attempt at 06:56:03 / ConnectionRefusedError: [Errno 111] Connection refused / attempt at 06:56:05 / answered', with postgres listening at 06:56:03.160; the uninstrumented run (infra-234-postgres-8a6d92) shows the same 2 s gap (check at 06:55:34Z, listener 06:55:35.258, next step 06:55:36Z). The page's own paragraph at 2765-2773 says why: Ready precedes the listener, so the first connection is refused and the loop retries. Fix: the bullet says the check answered after a refused first attempt (or drops 'on its first try'), and the PR body's E2E (implementer) line likewise. No repository test pins this: the defect is a sentence of prose, and a test reading the document's text is a source-text test; the run log is the pin.
